hunks.baseline: Instead of blood spraying before his eyes, Jeok Cheongang’s figure scattered like mist.
hunks.sol: Instead of spraying blood, Jeok Cheongang’s form dissolved like mist before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: Returning to Simplicity and Shifting Form and Position were both domains permitted only to Supreme Peak masters. That meant Cheongpung had grown up around someone who stood at the same realm stage as him.
hunks.sol: Returning to Simplicity and Shifting Form and Position were both domains permitted only to Supreme Peak masters. That meant Cheongpung had grown up beside a master of that same realm stage.

hunks.baseline: “What an obtuse brat. How would this old man know who your grandfather is?”
hunks.sol: “What a dense brat. How would this old man know who your grandfather is?”

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung licked his lips, looking troubled.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung smacked his lips, looking troubled.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung pointed at Jin Taekyung, who stood frozen like a monument.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung pointed at Jin Taekyung, who stood frozen like a statue.

hunks.baseline: Hot steam rose in wisps from his entire body, which had been heated to a reddish hue.
hunks.sol: His whole body had flushed red, and hot steam rose from it in wisps.

hunks.baseline: “I owe that gentleman a little. How could I just stand by while you bully my Benefactor, sir?”
hunks.sol: “I owe that gentleman a bit. How could I just stand by while you bully my Benefactor, Grandpa?”

hunks.baseline: The difference in their levels was absolute.
hunks.sol: They were on a completely different level.

hunks.baseline: At this moment, everything surrounding Jeok Cheongang was both his weapon and his shield. The corner of his wrinkled mouth rose slightly.
hunks.sol: At this moment, everything surrounding Jeok Cheongang was both his weapon and his shield. The corner of his wrinkled mouth curled up slightly.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, Hyuk Mujin’s vision turned white. A palm strike struck him in the chest, and he dropped helplessly to his knees.
hunks.sol: The next moment, Hyuk Mujin’s vision turned white. A palm slammed into his chest, and he dropped helplessly to his knees.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry. He should have suffered no more than a minor Internal Injury. More importantly…”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. He should have suffered no more than a minor Internal Injury. That aside…”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang was surprised by the visit of a master who could be compared to himself, but his answer had already been decided.
hunks.sol: It was the first time in his life that a master comparable to himself had come calling, and Jeok Cheongang was surprised. But his answer was already decided.

hunks.baseline: Even if the master of the Murim changed, the world itself would remain the same. There were villains in the orthodox faction and good people in the Demonic Cult.
hunks.sol: Even if the Murim changed hands, the world itself would remain the same. There were villains in the orthodox faction and good people in the Demonic Cult.

hunks.baseline: Mae Jonghak was lost in thought for a long while before suddenly tapping his forehead.
hunks.sol: Mae Jonghak was lost in thought for a long while before suddenly slapping his forehead.

hunks.baseline: Mae Jonghak was ten years younger than him, yet he was already an astonishingly powerful master.
hunks.sol: Mae Jonghak was at least ten years younger than him, yet he was already an astonishingly powerful master.
